fact: The Pinwheel Galaxy, a large face-on spiral in Ursa Major, about 22 million light-years away.
bio: Pierre Méchain discovered it in 1781. NASA gives its bright disc as about 170,000 light-years across, wider than the Milky Way's. Distance measurements from Cepheid stars and the tip of the red giant branch converge on about 21 to 22 million light-years, not NASA's 25 million. Supernova SN 2011fe, a Type Ia, went off in it in 2011 and is among the nearest of its kind. Hubble's 2006 view used 51 exposures.
